date_basis: Client date for handoff; raw report timestamps and host generation retained separately

scope: Bilibili video sources registered by owner-declared BVID against an explicit configuration revision; identity columns immutable, one source per agent/BVID, re-registration required after configuration revision changes

Database trigger state machine for subtitle/transcribe/frames jobs: queued to running or cancelled, running to done/failed/cancelled/unknown, terminal states immutable, done requires its artifact row and a finish stamp, at most 8 queued/running jobs per source

Alternative providers bounded by the service: 2 concurrent active jobs, 256 MiB / 180 s download budget, 4 MiB / 900 s transcript budget, 180 s frame budget; overruns and crashes become unknown, business rejections become failed

Transcripts and frame sheets published as immutable evidence rows plus object-store bodies only; ASR workers publish transcript.json directly, frame sheets are a composed image for model input, not an understanding result

Read-only model tools media_list and media_transcript expose only ActionResult.text: header line plus [MM:SS-MM:SS] anchored segments, windowed at most 12000 characters with explicit truncation markers

Cancel, restart recovery and delete propagation closed: media_recover returns counts reported by the lifecycle log, sources delete cascades only when not busy, revoked configuration strands its sources with bilibili_configuration_revoked

Twelve HTTP endpoints for sources, jobs, cancel, transcript windows, frames and processor probe, plus a workbench media section with registration, job submit/list/cancel, transcript paging, frame sheet preview and processor probing

targeted_reports.note: Full existing workbench browser regression rerun after the media section landed; produced after the source archive was sealed, so it is referenced here but not inside source-and-evidence.zip

validation.report_method: Chronological latest 133 distinct node outcomes across the media service/HTTP suite and fixed migration package, the 390/1024 media panel browser flow, Bilibili/HTTP caller regressions, architecture/worker/frozen-migration guards, plus the full 73-case workbench browser regression. No full suite; original failures retained.
resolved_development_failures: Job execution read a source snapshot from the job row that does not carry one, so every job stalled in queued; the source is now read explicitly after media_job_start
The ASR branch never assigned its publish body and raised NameError after a successful worker run; the worker-written transcript.json is now the published payload
media_recover wrote a global audit row with no agent scope and violated the audit foreign key; it now returns counts that the lifecycle logs instead
Source and job pagination compared created_at while passing an id cursor, so every second page came back empty; both now order and compare on id
Workbench loadSources cleared the selected source unconditionally and crashed the detail view after registration; the selection is cleared only when it disappears
The media panel browser flow needed the owner token file polled through server.started and job ids polled from the service, because repeated identical UI status text is not a sync point

open_findings.scope: 旧精确整理UI在本批一次刷新显示queued；同源码单节点独立复核通过，未判定已修复或稳定验收通过。

limitations: Windows with isolated fake Bilibili gateway, fake media processor and local accounts; no real Bilibili video, real ASR model quality or platform codec action

Frame sheets are model input material only; understanding quality depends on the selected model and is not measured here

Historical exact-organization UI single refresh timing failure remains a separate open finding
